question: Who among the following clocked 20.52 seconds in the men's 200 m final of the Federation Cup 2022 to break Muhammed Anas Yahiya's previous national record of 20.63 created at a meet in the Czech Republic back in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jinson Johnson.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jinson Johnson:**

 
 
• He clocked **20.52 seconds** in the **men's 200m final** of the **Federation Cup 2022** to break **Muhammed Anas Yahiya'**s previous national record of **20.63** created at a meet in the** Czech Republic** back in **2018.**
 
• He is a middle-distance runner who specializes in the **800m and 1500m** races. 
 
• He has won** gold medals** at the **Asian Games** and Asian Championships in these events.
 
• He's achievement of breaking the national record in the 200m race is significant as it is** not his usual event **and shows his versatility as an athlete.
 
• **Muhammed Anas Yahiya's national record in the 200m race stood for almost four years before Johnson broke it, highlighting the difficulty of achieving such a feat.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Surendra Singh:**

 
 
• Born on October 1, 1978,** He is an Indian long-distance runner who competed in the 10,000 metres and represented his country in Beijing in the 2008 Summer Olympics.**
 
• In the event, he finished 26th. With speeds of 7:50.31 minutes for the 3000 metres and 28:02.89 minutes for the 10,000 metres, he owns the Indian records in these events.
 
 
 
• **Amlan Borgohain:**
 
 
• I**ndian track and field athlete Amlan Borgohain was born on April 25, 1998, and he specialises in the 100 and 200 metres.**
 
• For both the 100 and 200 metres, he currently owns the Indian national record. In April 2022, he broke the 200-meter national mark, then in August 2022, he smashed the 100-meter national record to become the fastest Indian ever.
 
• **He won the gold in the 100- and 200-meter events in the 2022 Indian National Games.**
 
 
 
• **Amiya Kumar Mallick;**
 
 
• **He is an Indian sprinter from Odisha who was born on November 14, 1992.**
 
• **His time of 10.26 seconds for the 100 metres is the national record.**
 
• Mallick, who ran a time of 21.33 seconds to win the **bronze in the 200 metres at the 2008 Commonwealth Youth Games.**
 
• **He won the silver in the 100 metres at the 2006 Junior Asian Meet in Colombo. **
